meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 安装一个只读的网页仪表盘：它从命令行工具读取资源列表，自动生成标签页和表格，并显示代理状态、消息活动、日志和文件查看面板。不修改项目源码，只新增一个工具文件夹。
howto.when: 当用户说出“添加 clidash”或“安装 clidash”时触发；适用于 NanoClaw 项目，通常需要存在 ncl 命令。

say.text: 请给这个 NanoClaw 项目添加 clidash 仪表盘。
say.note: 开始复制工具并生成配置。

say.text: 安装 clidash 并启动服务，然后验证一下。
say.note: 会运行测试并启动本地服务。

say.text: 帮我把 clidash 装上，再加进 .gitignore。
say.note: 安装并忽略本地配置文件。

howto.what_en: Installs a read-only web dashboard deriving tabs/tables at runtime from CLI JSON output. Pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl: agent status cards, activity charts, log tail, file viewer. No source changes, zero dependencies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add or install clidash. Intended for NanoClaw projects, assuming ncl is built or can be built.

say_en.text: Please add the clidash dashboard to this NanoClaw project.
say_en.note: Copies the tool and creates the config.

say_en.text: Install clidash, start the service, and verify it.
say_en.note: Runs tests and starts the local server.

say_en.text: Set up clidash and add its config to .gitignore.
say_en.note: Installs and ignores local config file.
